newsitem.title: UK: NatWest appoints former BoE director to boar.
newsitem.headline: NatWest appoints former BoE director to boar.

text.p: Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc said on Tuesday it had appointed former Bank of England executive director Pen Kent as a board director.
Kent, who retired from Britain's central bank at the end of February, will take up his role on September 1, NatWest said in a statement.

When he joins the board, Kent will become a member of the group's audit and compliance committee and NatWest Markets' board and audit and compliance committee. NatWest Markets is the investment banking arm of NatWest.
